narrative: 崩溃、虚荣、一个谎言：浴室或化妆间的实景灯、近景中的银镜面、镜子里房间的碎片。百眼视觉（Argus）是很多只眼睛。
而这个是一张碎裂成片的脸。一张团队合影不需要这个。
当碎片没有各自映出房间的不同部分时，它就是错误的工具；如果你想要的是完整的反射（Reflections），它也是错误的用法。玻璃在这里是一种剪切。
how: 透过镜面固定机位，35mm到50mm焦段，浴室实景灯。裂开的银镜面、同一个人被切成多个碎片，碎片要看起来是玻璃，而不是万花筒滤镜。
提示词：Prompt: Broken-mirror of [Subject], silver shards, one face that does not agree with itself.
when: 一次对着镜子的崩溃、被撕裂的虚荣、一个谎言。不要把它当作贴在单人肖像上的裂纹贴纸来用，也不要用在团队合影上。
vs: 碎片化剪辑（Fragments）是把镜头素材剪成碎片的剪辑手法。反射（Reflections）是完整的玻璃。
碎镜风则是镜头前实拍的裂开银镜面，每块碎片映出脸和房间的不同部分。如果每一块碎片都完全一致，你得到的只是一个滤镜。
examples_film: 《黑天鹅》（Black Swan）的化妆间用玻璃把一位舞者分裂开来。黑色电影（Film Noir）的浴室场景把镜子当作道德层面的剪切。
玻璃即剪切。这是语法，不是照搬某个浴室场景。
mistakes: 一张叠加了裂纹贴图的脸，或完整的反射。破绽是每块碎片都是同一个角度。
修正方法：玻璃碎片、房间的不同部分，以及一张与自己不一致的脸。

faq.q: 电影中的碎镜风（Broken Mirror）是什么？
faq.a: 裂开的银镜面成为身份分裂的象征：一张脸的碎片彼此不一致，每一块都呈现出略微不同的角度或时间。不是一张裂纹贴纸。

faq.q: 碎镜风（Broken Mirror）与反射（Reflections）的区别
faq.a: 反射用的是完整的玻璃。碎镜风用的是互相不一致的碎片。如果镜子是完整的，你想要的是反射。
崩溃、虚荣、谎言。跳过团队合影和贴图式的裂纹。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写碎镜风的提示词？
faq.a: 先写浴室实景灯，然后要求每块碎片都映出房间的不同部分。

narrative: Breakdowns, vanity, a lie: bathroom or dressing-room practical, silver in the near plane, pieces of room in the glass. Argus is many eyes.
This is one face in pieces. A team photo does not want this.
It is the wrong tool when the shards do not hold different bits of the room, and the wrong tool if you wanted intact Reflections. Glass as a cut.
how: Lock off through the glass, 35mm to 50mm, bathroom practical. Cracked silver, multiple slices of the same person, shards as glass not as a kaleidoscope filter.
Prompt: Broken-mirror of [Subject], silver shards, one face that does not agree with itself.
when: A breakdown at a mirror, vanity that splits, a lie. Do not use it as a crack sticker on a single portrait, and do not use it for a team photo.
vs: Fragments is editing as shards of coverage. Reflections is intact glass.
Broken mirror is cracked silver in camera, different bits of face and room per shard. If every piece matches, you have a filter.
examples_film: Black Swan dressing rooms split a dancer across glass. Film-noir bathrooms use mirrors as moral cuts.
Glass as a cut. Grammar, not a copied bathroom.
mistakes: A face with a crack overlay, or intact Reflections. The tell is one angle in every shard.
Fix it: glass pieces, different bits of room, face that does not agree with itself.

faq.q: What is Broken Mirror in film?
faq.a: Cracked silver as a split of identity: shards of one face that do not agree, each piece a slightly different angle or time. Not a crack sticker.
Reflections uses intact glass. Broken mirror uses shards that disagree. If the mirror is whole, you wanted reflections.

faq.q: When should I use Broken Mirror?
faq.a: Breakdowns, vanity, a lie. Skip team photos and overlay cracks.

faq.q: How do I prompt Broken Mirror for AI image or video?
faq.a: Bathroom practical, then: Broken-mirror of [Subject], silver shards, one face that does not agree with itself. Each shard must hold a different bit of room.
